profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a seasoned software engineer with extensive experience in distributed streaming data processing, scalable microservice architecture, and static program analysis-based software testing. As an Apache Beam committer, I have focused on improving SDK language portability across platforms. I also led the development of Sparrow, a leading static analysis-based software testing solution in Korea.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a large-scale migration of server-side computation in ZippyDB, Meta’s distributed key-value store, from a limited expression DSL to a bytecode-compiled language platform, driving adoption from an early rollout to near completion. Built production-grade validation safeguards and delivered core language and compiler features including pattern matching, tuples, casting, native-function integration, and expanded syntax.

- Improved correctness, reliability, and maintainability through formal verification, fuzzing, equivalence testing, and statistically rigorous performance benchmarking. Built cross-language schema and type-system tooling across Python, Hack, C++, and Rust, and led code-quality automation that eliminated 1,000+ issues.

- Expanded the platform and developer ecosystem through build infrastructure, code generation, command-line tooling, and customer discovery. Drove technical direction through design proposals and cross-team collaboration, mentored engineers, and explored AI-assisted approaches to research and compiler optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: Thrift · C++ · Rust · AI Agent

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description: - Enhanced analysis result quality for popular programming languages (Java, JS/TS, Go, Python, Scala), encompassing tasks from maintaining tree-sitter parsers to optimizing dataflow analyzers and pattern matchers. Additionally, designed and developed enhancements for type and name inference in target source code, including virtual method invocation resolution and semantic querying operators for metavariables (e.g., querying entity types or fully qualified names). Also designed and implemented cross-file differential (PR) scanning, which significantly reduced scan times while maintaining result quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Contributing to designing and implementation of Apache Beam. Improving the stability and the performance of various IO modules such as ParquetIO, BigQueryIO, KafkaIO and TextIO. Improving the portability and the performance of Dataflow runner, Flink runner and Java/Python worker harnesses. Contributing to a new artifact staging model and API for multi-language pipelines.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Beam · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Java · Python

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing a data proxy service which aims to provide a uniform RESTful interface for querying heterogeneous databases such as Postgres, Impala and AWS Athena. Built with Finagle, Thrift, Doobie and Scala.

- Developing static analyzers for Android and iOS apps to detect any malicious behavior. Built with Soot, Capstone disassembler, Fastparse and Scala.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer of Sparrow Java, the static program analyzer for finding semantic bugs such as null dereferences and resource leaks. Built with Soot, Antlr and Scala.

positions.title: Visiting Scholar
positions.description: Developing static analysis framework for Android applications

positions.title: Visiting Scholar
positions.description: Developing general recommendation engine for NSDL

educations.schoolName: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
